svg.text: Blood-volume LA PV is the only physiology-facing display here. Prime readbacks are ignored for the current SVG and morphology gate.
Current visual prefilter: source surface, MVF, blood-volume PV phase, clean post-MV-opening conduit downstroke, hidden-volume cleanliness, and blood V-loop area.
V17 1/7 phase, source 6/7, MVF 6/7; V18 1/7 phase, source 3/7, MVF 4/7; V19 1/7 phase, source 3/7, MVF 4/7
V20 1/7 phase, source 4/7, MVF 5/7; V21 0/7 phase, source 5/7, MVF 5/7. This is residual review, not morphology acceptance.
